items.title: Canonical functorial isomorphism between the determinants of a finite length module over a local ring and over a local quotient-ring extension with the same residue field
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For a local homomorphism of local rings (R', m') -> (R, m) inducing an isomorphism on residue fields, the lemma asserts that the restriction M_{R'} of a finite length R-module is again of finite length and that there is a canonical isomorphism det_{R,kappa}(M) -> det_{R',kappa}(M_{R'}), functorial in M and compatible with the isomorphism gamma of the additivity lemma for short exact sequences (statement lines 16433-16447). The proof has three parts: the length is preserved, by the algebra lemma on pushdown of a module of finite length; an admissible sequence over R is again admissible over R' because m' maps into m, which is what makes the symbol comparison possible; and the isomorphism is defined by sending the symbol [x_1, ..., x_l] in det_{R,kappa}(M) to the corresponding symbol in det_{R',kappa}(M), after which functoriality and compatibility with gamma are immediate to verify (proof lines 16450-16462). Observing that admissibility is inherited along the map on maximal ideals, which is what makes the symbol-wise definition legitimate, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
